name: News Corporation
hidden_asset: 62.0% of REA Group (ASX: REA) plus 80% of Move (realtor.com)
key_assumptions: REA at ASX price A$162.89 (2026-11-18) less 21% tax; DJ 11x, HarperCollins 7x, News Media 3x Segment EBITDA FY Jun-2026; corporate cost capitalised at 6x; mcap = 358.3m A x $26.13 + 178.9m B x $29.17
unlock_signal: None on REA. Buyback ($1bn 2025 program, $501m left at 30 Sep 2026) is the only lever; Foxtel sale to DAZN (Apr 2025) shows they will sell non-core
trap_risk: REA is a tax-trapped foreign stake inside a Murdoch-controlled dual-class company that has never shown intent to distribute it; REA itself fell to A$163 from 2025 highs
one_line_note: REA stake is ~61% of the market cap pre-tax; after tax and plain multiples on the rest the cushion is only ~10%
sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1564708/000156470826000250/nws-20260930.htm (10-Q Q1 FY27, filed 2026-11-05);https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1564708/000156470826000175/nws-20260630.htm (10-K FY Jun-2026, filed 2026-08-07);yfinance REA.AX, NWSA, NWS, AUDUSD close 2026-11-18

name: Loews Corporation
hidden_asset: ~92% of CNA Financial (listed) plus 100% Boardwalk Pipelines and Loews Hotels
key_assumptions: CNA at market $48.48 x ~92%; Boardwalk 9x EBITDA; parent net cash $2.6bn; 202.2m shares at $109.98
unlock_signal: Steady buybacks (3.2m shares, $345m in 9M-2026); no spin or sale of CNA or Boardwalk announced
trap_risk: Classic conglomerate discount that never closes because the Tisch family prefers to buy back stock slowly; Boardwalk capex rising to $845m in 2026
one_line_note: The parts add to only ~5% above the market cap; the famous Loews discount has mostly closed
sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/60086/000006008626000056/l-20260930.htm (10-Q Q3 2026, filed 2026-11-02);https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/60086/000006008626000008/l-20251231.htm (10-K 2025, debt note 11);yfinance CNA, L close 2026-11-18

name: Bio-Rad Laboratories, Inc.
hidden_asset: 38% of Sartorius AG ordinary and 28% of preference shares (Frankfurt-listed) plus a EUR400m loan secured on Sartorius trust interests
key_assumptions: Sartorius at XETRA 2026-11-18 prices; 21% tax on a near-zero basis; core at 10x FCF; EUR/USD 1.0996
unlock_signal: None. Bio-Rad has held Sartorius for decades; the EUR400m loan (2021) is a bet on getting more Sartorius ordinary shares when the family trust ends in mid-2028
trap_risk: The stake is two-thirds of the market cap and Bio-Rad keeps buying more exposure instead of selling; core business is shrinking at a 2.7% 3-year revenue rate with a 2% GAAP operating margin
one_line_note: Sartorius is worth $6.6bn pre-tax vs a $10.0bn market cap, but after tax the market already pays about full value for both pieces
sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/12208/000001220826000058/bio-20260930.htm (10-Q Q3 2026);yfinance SRT.DE, SRT3.DE, BIO, EURUSD close 2026-11-18;triage/metrics.csv (FY2025 revenue, FCF)
unlock_score: low (2028 trust end is a possible event)

name: Equitable Holdings, Inc.
hidden_asset: 68.3% economic interest in AllianceBernstein (199.3m AB Units + GP interest)
key_assumptions: AB Units valued at AB Holding price (carries its own tax drag); segment operating earnings 9M-2026 x 4/3; insurer at 6x
unlock_signal: EQH raised its AB stake to ~68% via the 2025 tender, the opposite of an unlock; heavy buybacks (weighted shares 277m vs 302m a year ago)
trap_risk: The 'rest' is a variable-annuity and RILA balance sheet whose value depends on reserve assumptions
one_line_note: AB stake ~45% of the market cap, but the parts only add to the market cap

name: Marathon Petroleum Corporation
hidden_asset: ~647m MPLX common units (~64%) plus the MPLX general partner
key_assumptions: MPLX at $57.38; R&M at 5x a mid-cycle $6bn EBITDA; MPC standalone net cash $6.0bn at 30 Sep 2026
unlock_signal: MPLX distributions ($1.2111/unit quarterly) already fund MPC's dividend; MPLX buyback; no change in structure planned
trap_risk: The hidden asset is fully visible (MPC itself prints the $36.5bn market value in its 10-Q); the stock is up 91% in a year on boom refining margins
one_line_note: Conservative SOTP is ~35% below the market cap: the market is paying for boom refining, not missing MPLX

name: Antero Resources Corporation
hidden_asset: Equity-method stake in Antero Midstream (fair value $2.8bn at 30 Sep 2026)
key_assumptions: AM stake per AR's own fair-value footnote; E&P at 6x OCF; gas-price sensitive
unlock_signal: None announced; AR keeps the AM stake as a hedge on its own gathering costs
trap_risk: Stake is disclosed at fair value every quarter, so it is not hidden; E&P value swings with gas prices
one_line_note: AM stake is 25% of the market cap but disclosed at fair value; no gap on a conservative E&P value
sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1433270/000110465926119637/ar-20260930x10q.htm (10-Q Q3 2026, investment note);triage/metrics.csv;yfinance AR, AM close 2026-11-18

name: MGM Resorts International
hidden_asset: ~56% of MGM China (HKEX: 2282) and 50% of BetMGM
key_assumptions: Leases capitalised at the balance-sheet liability; LV Strip EBITDAR fell 5% in 9M-2026 (2,015 vs 2,123)
unlock_signal: None; MGM sold MGM Northfield Park operations (Apr 2026) and buys back stock
trap_risk: Hidden assets look large against an $8.5bn cap until you count $23.9bn of lease liabilities owed to VICI and others
one_line_note: Lease-adjusted, the parts are worth about half the market cap

name: JD.com, Inc.
hidden_asset: Listed subsidiaries JD Logistics (~64%), JD Health (~67%), JD Industrials, plus a profitable JD Retail core masked by New Businesses losses
key_assumptions: Ownership %s approximate (2025 20-F, not re-verified); JD Retail at 6x operating income; 50% of net cash credited; FX 0.1275 HKD, 0.1502 CNY
unlock_signal: Buybacks continue; but capital is going outward (CECONOMY 59.8% for EUR1.34bn closed 2026-11-12; food delivery) rather than to distributing JDL/JD Health
trap_risk: China/VIE and SAMR risk (the release cites a SAMR fine); New Businesses losses can widen again; cash is partly supplier money (payables RMB198bn)
one_line_note: Listed stakes alone are ~half the market cap and the retail core earns ~$8bn a year; the gap is large but sits behind China risk and an acquisitive habit
sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1549802/000119312526464688/d179042dex991.htm (6-K EX-99.1 Q3-2026 results, 2026-11-17);https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1549802/000119312526456897/d114554dex991.htm (6-K CECONOMY completion, 2026-11-12);yfinance JD, 2618.HK, 6618.HK, 7618.HK close 2026-11-18

name: Baidu, Inc.
hidden_asset: RMB276.6bn ($41.3bn) of cash and investments plus AI Cloud (+94% y/y), Kunlunxin chips and Apollo Go inside a shrinking search-ad business
key_assumptions: Cash and investments per company definition (includes adjusted long-term investments) haircut 15%; general business at 4x EBITDA; AI options at zero
unlock_signal: First-ever dividend expected to be declared before end-2026 (Q3 release); buybacks running (HK next-day disclosures); Kunlunxin M100 volume production by end-2026
trap_risk: Cash is largely onshore RMB and is being spent on AI capex (FY2025 FCF -$2.2bn); search ads are shrinking; investments include illiquid stakes at book
one_line_note: Market cap sits below cash and investments net of debt; the ad business, cloud, chips and robotaxis come almost free
sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1329099/000119312526462286/d767848dex991.htm (6-K EX-99.1 Q3-2026 results, 2026-11-16);yfinance BIDU, IQ close 2026-11-18;triage/metrics.csv (FY2025 FCF)

name: Ford Motor Company
hidden_asset: Ford Pro (commercial vehicles, software and service; 2026 EBIT guide ~$7.0bn) and Ford Credit, buried under Model e losses
key_assumptions: Segment guidance from the Q3-2026 10-Q outlook; Pro 6x EBIT, Blue 3x, Model e losses capitalised at -3x; Credit 6x after-tax
unlock_signal: None: Ford reports Pro as a segment but has never suggested separating it; Model e losses are shrinking ($1.06bn Q3 loss vs $1.41bn)
trap_risk: Pro shares plants, platforms and the F-Series with Blue, so it cannot be separated cleanly; Pro EBIT is falling (2024 ~$9bn, 2026 guide ~$7bn) as competition and tariffs bite
one_line_note: Ford Pro alone at 6x EBIT is ~93% of the market cap; the gap exists only if Model e losses keep shrinking
sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/37996/000003799626000191/f-20260930.htm (10-Q Q3 2026, segment note and outlook);yfinance F close 2026-11-18

name: Tenet Healthcare Corporation
hidden_asset: USPI ambulatory surgery business (Ambulatory Care segment) inside a hospital operator
key_assumptions: Segment Adjusted EBITDA from the 10-Q segment note annualised; NCI capitalised at market-like 12x because USPI partners own large slices
unlock_signal: Aggressive buybacks ($1.6bn in 9M-2026; treasury shares up to 79.7m); no spin of USPI
trap_risk: USPI's minority partners take a big share of the profit, so 'Tenet's share' is much less than segment EBITDA; hospital EBITDA is exposed to Medicaid and exchange-subsidy changes
one_line_note: After paying the minority partners, the USPI premium leaves only ~10% of conservative upside

name: Hasbro, Inc.
hidden_asset: Wizards of the Coast and Digital Gaming (Magic, D&D, licensed digital games) inside a toy company
key_assumptions: Segment operating profit from the 10-Q segment note; Q4 run-rate estimated
unlock_signal: Already unlocked by the market: stock +62% in a year; no separation planned
trap_risk: Magic revenue is lumpy and set-driven; the 'hidden' growth line is now the main thing the market pays for
one_line_note: Wizards earns ~85% of segment profit; the market already pays more than a conservative SOTP

name: EchoStar Corporation
hidden_asset: ~261.8m SpaceX Class A shares receivable at the spectrum closing (targeted 30 Nov 2027), plus AT&T sale cash
key_assumptions: SpaceX at the contract value; Seller Notes treated as passing to SpaceX; tax liability deducted in full
unlock_signal: Closing itself (Nov 2027) turns the receivable into SpaceX stock; a SpaceX listing would mark it to market
trap_risk: The stock already prices SpaceX near twice the deal value; closing is conditional, and residual Boost/DISH liabilities are unclear
one_line_note: At the contract price the parts are ~25% below the market cap: investors are paying for SpaceX upside, not missing it
sources: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1415404/000110465926121675/sats-20260930x10q.htm (10-Q Q3 2026, Note 1 SpaceX Transactions);yfinance ECHO close 2026-11-18

name: Cameco Corporation
